I am 76 years old now, and my bones are not as strong as they used to be, but I know this land well after farming it for many years. I will plant improved maize seed because it gives better yield than our local seed, and I will apply cow manure and a small handful of chemical fertilizer since the soil needs help, though money is tight. My family will do the weeding and most of the work ourselves because the plot is small, but I will hire a few young men for the heavy land preparation. We do not irrigate here in Mbeya because the rains usually come in season, and I do not buy pesticides for this intercropped field.
